notes.meaning: The psalmist calls every nation and all peoples across the earth to praise the LORD. Worship was never meant to stay within Israel alone, for God's glory belongs to the whole world. The apostle Paul used these words to show that God always planned to welcome the Gentiles, people who are not Jewish, to worship Him.

God gives all people a reason to praise Him: His loving mercy is powerful and wins the victory over our sin. His truth and faithfulness never run out and will stand forever. Because the Lord unfailingly keeps every promise He makes, people from every land can rest securely in Him.
